correctness.rationale: For all n>=4 the rungs plus disjoint paired column-rails classify every matching except exactly two odd-width rim matchings. Square flips toggle one independent cyclic dimer. In odd width all regular matchings have an odd number of rungs whereas exceptions have none; an odd-rung simple alternating cycle must wind once and use at least n rail edges, hence length >=n+1. The one-rung matching formed from two even rim paths is connected to each exception by one alternating (n+1)-cycle, establishing the matching upper bound and the exact threshold. All parameter boundaries checked, with independent exhaustive finite corroboration through n=11 and n=12.
